biggest_catch: Microsoft publishes no fixed per-search rate or daily cap — observed variants showed 5 points per search, but limits vary by market and account, so the catalog's cap figures are not official and you must check your own dashboard.
catches: Variable earnings: the per-search rate and daily caps differ by market and account — observed US variants showed 5 points per search, but this is not a published guarantee.
Payout threshold: points only become anything when redeemed for gift cards, donations, or sweepstakes entries — small daily search activity accumulates slowly.
Privacy/data collection: you must search with Bing signed in; Microsoft ties search activity to your account profile.
Variable availability: Rewards availability, earning limits, and redemption options differ by country.
The catalog's 'points per search (daily cap)' framing is unconfirmed as official figures.

c1.evidence: Microsoft Rewards is a real operating program by Microsoft; official pages live at microsoft.com/en-us/rewards.

c2.evidence: The official Microsoft Rewards pages confirm the mechanism: signed-in users earn points for mobile Bing searches, and points redeem for gift cards, donations, and sweepstakes entries.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee to join Microsoft Rewards or earn points.

c4.evidence: No fixed payout amount exists in official terms — payout_quote is null. The pay MECHANISM is verified: mobile Bing searches earn points redeemable for gift cards/donations/sweepstakes; per-search rates and daily caps vary by market/account (observed variants showed 5 points/search) and are not published guarantees.

eligibility: A Microsoft account; Microsoft Rewards availability, earning limits, and redemption options vary by market.
notes: Verified mechanism-only from the official Microsoft Rewards pages (observed 2026-09-23). s3.note: Points accrue per search up to the user's daily limit; limits vary by market/account — check your dashboard.

steps: Sign in to your Microsoft account (create one free if needed).
On your phone, search with Bing while signed in — each search earns Microsoft Rewards points up to your daily limit.
Open your Microsoft Rewards dashboard to see your own per-search rate and daily cap, which vary by market and account.
Let points accumulate through daily mobile searching.
Redeem points from the rewards catalog for gift cards, donations, or sweepstakes entries.
timing: Points accrue per Bing search up to your daily limit; limits vary by market and account — check your dashboard.
